root_cause: The NPU Models Tests jobs (groups 3720, 5010, 5020, 4000, 6010) pip-install HF transformer test requirements that resolve to a pyarrow build requiring NumPy>=2.0, while the Windows venv still has an older NumPy 1.26.4 pinned by another dependency in the same requirements set. When test_hf_transformers.py imports `datasets`, which imports `pyarrow`, the native pyarrow.lib extension raises ImportError due to the ABI/version mismatch. PR #39512 only modifies a benchmarks CSV doc file and is unrelated to this failure; the identical signature has now recurred 5 times in the pattern database across multiple Windows/Linux workflows in the last ~36 hours, confirming an environment/dependency-pinning issue rather than a PR-introduced regression.
reproduction_steps:
1. Build/obtain the openvino wheels as in job_npu_tests.yml on a Windows runner.
2. Install install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch requirements as done in CI.
3. Run: python -m pytest install\tests\model_hub_tests\pytorch\test_hf_transformers.py -k bert-base-uncased -v
4. Observe ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4 when the test imports `datasets`.
recommended_actions: Pin a pyarrow version compatible with NumPy 1.26.x (e.g. pyarrow<18) in the model_hub_tests/pytorch requirements, OR upgrade numpy to >=2.0 in that same requirements file so pyarrow's ABI matches.
Audit model_hub_tests requirements files (Windows and Linux variants) for conflicting numpy/pyarrow pins and align them across platforms.

Add a CI smoke check that imports `datasets`/`pyarrow` right after dependency installation to fail fast with a clear message instead of deep inside a multiprocessing worker, on both Linux and Windows runners.
prevention_strategies: Pin compatible numpy/pyarrow versions together in all requirements files used by PyTorch model-hub tests (Linux and Windows), and add a `pip check` step after installing test requirements to catch ABI-incompatible combinations before running tests.
historical_context: This is the 5th recorded occurrence of the same pyarrow/NumPy ABI mismatch (signature_hash 90d42369fa7c1efb) within roughly the last 36 hours, previously seen on runs 41939333537, 41968975085, 42062435152, and 42251179008 (Linux workflow of this same merge-queue attempt for PR #39512). This run is the Windows counterpart of the same merge-queue attempt, confirming the issue is environment-wide and platform-independent, not isolated to one OS or PR.
